raw_resume.summary: B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering graduate (2025) who builds full-stack web applications with Java, Spring Boot and React. Seeking the Software Engineer II, Google Cloud role to contribute to distributed systems and large-scale product development.

projects.name: PaySplit - Group Expense Settlement
projects.description: Built a Spring Boot REST API and React TypeScript frontend to split shared expenses. Integrated Razorpay test-mode payments with webhooks for created, captured and refunded states. Wrote 40 JUnit tests and containerised the app with Docker.

projects.name: Campus Library Reservations
projects.description: Developed a Java and Spring Boot service with MySQL schema for booking study rooms; piloted for 2 weeks with 120 students and eliminated double bookings.

projects.name: Order Tracker Dashboard
projects.description: Built a React and TypeScript dashboard consuming a REST API to track order status, deployed locally with Docker Compose.

profile_improvement_tips: Learn Python or JavaScript to match the JD's core language requirements; both are widely used in Google Cloud services and will significantly strengthen your candidacy.
Build a project demonstrating System Design principles (e.g. designing a scalable microservices architecture, load balancing, or caching strategies) to show readiness for distributed systems work.
Gain hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services such as Compute Engine, Cloud Functions, or Firestore; create a small project deployed on GCP to evidence this skill.
raw_resume.growth_note: You are a strong fresher with solid full-stack fundamentals in Java and React, but the Software Engineer II role at Google Cloud requires 1+ year of professional experience and proficiency in multiple languages (Python, JavaScript, C++). You currently have 0 professional years and only Java from the required language list. Recommend gaining 1-2 years of industry experience, learning Python or JavaScript, and building distributed systems projects before applying.
